name: The Sol Reclamation
description: Repair the station's defense grid by recovering a Sol Unit.

talk_to_warden.label: Talk to Warden Holt
talk_to_warden.description: Find Warden Holt in the outpost entrance.

get_weapon.label: Get a Weapon
get_weapon.description: Head to the munitions depot and get a weapon from Quartermaster Voss.

talk_to_engineer.label: Talk to the Engineer
talk_to_engineer.description: Visit the workshop and speak with the Sol Engineer.

find_warlord_key.label: Defeat the Warlord
find_warlord_key.description: Descend to the deepest level of the quarantine wing and defeat the luddite warlord.

open_supply_crate.label: Open the Supply Crate
open_supply_crate.description: Backtrack to level 2 and use the warlord's key on the locked supply crate.

return_to_engineer.label: Return to the Engineer
return_to_engineer.description: Bring the titanium cylinders back to the workshop.

equip_damage_booster.label: Equip the Damage Booster
equip_damage_booster.description: Open your Sol Grid and place the Damage Booster next to the Sol Cone.

engineer_briefing.label: Talk to the Engineer
engineer_briefing.description: Talk to the Sol Engineer about your Sol Grid setup.

training_range.label: Complete Sol Training
training_range.description: Head to the training range and destroy the targets.

charge_sol_unit.label: Get a field battery from Tech Maren
charge_sol_unit.description: Head to the Power Station and talk to Tech Maren — the station can't do full charge cycles yet, but she keeps single-use field cells for deployment.

report_to_warden.label: Report to Warden Holt
report_to_warden.description: Return to the outpost entrance and report to Warden Holt that you're equipped and ready to deploy.

cross_perimeter.label: Cross the Dark Perimeter
cross_perimeter.description: Pass through the perimeter gate and traverse the dangerous outer ring to reach the train station.

talk_to_yara.label: Talk to Tech Yara
talk_to_yara.description: Tech Yara at the train station may know how to get a transit pass. Find her and hear her out.

clear_junction_box.label: Clear the Underground Power Conduit Junction
clear_junction_box.description: Junction Box 7 in the underground power conduit has been overrun by Dusk Crawlers. Clear them out so Yara can restore the train power.

get_transit_pass.label: Collect Your Transit Pass
get_transit_pass.description: Return to Tech Yara — the junction is clear and she owes you a Transit Pass.

board_train.label: Board the Train to Meridian City
board_train.description: Use your Transit Pass to open the platform gate and board the train.

arrive_meridian.label: Arrive at Meridian City
arrive_meridian.description: You've boarded the train. Ride it to Meridian City and explore the station.

visit_civic_center.label: Claim Your Salvage Yard
visit_civic_center.description: Head east from the station to the Civic Center and claim a salvage lot from Land Registrar Hollis. This is where you'll build your own solar infrastructure — half the game is dungeon crawling, the other half is building your array.

visit_workshop.label: Visit the Workshop District
visit_workshop.description: Head west from the station to the Workshop District and meet Master Crafter Yun.

explore_dayside.label: Explore the Dayside Solar Fields
explore_dayside.description: Yun says the Array controls the dayside — automated harvesters, solar panels, all of it. Visit the Dayside Solar Fields through the Array Hub to see the Array's infrastructure firsthand.

discover_array_secret.label: Discover the Array's Secret
discover_array_secret.description: MERIDIAN-7 trades umbracite for infrastructure, but something deeper is going on. Find the Array Deep Processing center and uncover what the Array doesn't want you to see.

build_alliance.label: Rally Sable and Confront MERIDIAN-7
build_alliance.description: The Array's secret changes everything. Warn Sable about what you found in the residential quarter, then confront MERIDIAN-7 at the Array Hub.

forge_expedition.label: Forge the Nightside Expedition
forge_expedition.description: With Sable warned and MERIDIAN-7 confronted, speak to Councillor Asha Denn at the Civic Center. She's assembling a joint expedition into the deep Nightside.
